tools.name: respira_inject_builder_content
tools.description:
REPLACE (or append to) the entire page builder layout. WARNING: By default this REPLACES all existing content — use mode:"append" to add content without destroying existing elements. For editing a single module, use wordpress_update_module instead. Use exactly: gutenberg, divi, elementor, bricks, beaver, oxygen, breakdance, brizy, thrive, visual-composer, wpbakery. For Divi, divi_version is required ("4" or "5"). Starting in plugin v7.0.16, calling this against a page that already has content with mode="replace" (the default) without also passing confirm_replace=true returns a 409 respira_replace_confirmation_required — pass mode="append" to add to existing content, pass mode="replace" AND confirm_replace=true to overwrite, or pass edit_target="live" to overwrite the live page directly (plugin v7.0.22+ accepts an authorized live edit as the confirmation). The gate prevents silent data loss.

Nested Divi 5 content shape — canonical: `content: [{ type: "section", settings: {...}, children: [{ type: "row", children: [{ type: "column", children: [{ type: "heading", settings: {...} }, ...] }] }] }]`. Plugin v7.0.32 also accepts `rows / cols / columns / modules / elements / innerBlocks` as aliases for `children` on Divi (Divi-vocabulary; soft warning surfaces in response.warnings). Plugin v7.0.32 hard-errors with `respira_children_dropped` (HTTP 500) if any container payload declares children but the emit produced fewer innerBlocks — silent data-loss is no longer possible.

builder.description: Builder identifier. Use exactly: gutenberg, divi, elementor, bricks, beaver, oxygen, breakdance, brizy, thrive, visual-composer, wpbakery.

content.description: Structured content to inject in simplified format. In "replace" mode (default), this REPLACES all existing content. In "append" mode, this is added after existing content. For Gutenberg: array of blocks [{type: "core/heading", attrs: {level: 2}, content: "Hello"}, {type: "core/paragraph", attrs: {}, content: "Text here"}]. For Beaver Builder: {rows: [{cols: [{modules: [{type: "rich-text", settings: {text: "..."}}]}]}]}. For Elementor: array of widget objects. For Divi: Divi shortcode or block structure. Use extract_builder_content to see the format for any builder.

mode.description: replace (default): OVERWRITES all existing page content. append: adds new content after existing elements, preserving the current layout. As of plugin v7.0.16, replace against a page with existing content requires confirm_replace=true.

confirm_replace.description: Required when mode="replace" (or unset, since replace is the default) AND the page already has content. Pass true only when you genuinely want to overwrite the existing structure. Without it, the plugin returns 409 respira_replace_confirmation_required so the agent can decide between mode="append" (preserve) and mode="replace"+confirm_replace=true (overwrite).

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_update_bricks_typography
tools.description: Update Bricks global CSS variables and typography. Pass variables array and optionally categories. Returns previous and current values for rollback.

variables.description: Array of variable objects: [{id, name, value, category}]

categories.description: Optional array of category objects: [{id, name, scale?: {prefix}}]. Categories with scale property define typography scales.

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_list_bricks_components

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_apply_bricks_component
tools.description: Insert a Bricks component/template into a page. Clones the component elements with new IDs and inserts them at the specified position. Creates a snapshot before writing.

component_id.description: Post ID of the bricks_template to apply

post_id.description: Target page/post ID to insert the component into

position.description: Where to insert: "start" (beginning), "end" (default, append), or a numeric index string like "3" for specific position

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_search_bricks_elements
tools.description: Search across ALL pages and templates for Bricks elements by type, global class, or setting value. Finds every instance of a specific element type, class usage, or setting across your entire site.

element_type.description: Bricks element type to search for (e.g. "heading", "text-basic", "image", "button", "container")

class_name.description: Global class name to find usage of (e.g. "card-shadow"). Resolves name to ID automatically.

setting_key.description: Setting key to search for (e.g. "tag", "link.url"). Used with setting_value.

setting_value.description: Setting value to match (used with setting_key)

post_type.description: Limit search to post type: "page", "post", "bricks_template", or "any" (default)

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_bricks_health_check

post_id.description: Page or post ID to check

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_bricks_detect_acss

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_bricks_query_loops

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_get_elementor_widget_schema

widget_type.description: Widget type name (e.g. "heading", "button", "image", "icon-box"). Use list_elementor_widgets to find available types.

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_update_elementor_global_colors
tools.description: Add or update global colors in the Elementor active kit. Merges by _id — existing colors with matching _id are updated, new _ids are appended. Does not delete existing colors.

colors.description: Array of color objects to add or update.

_id.description: Unique color ID (e.g. "brand_primary", "accent"). Must be unique across all custom colors.

color.description: Color value — hex (#FF5733), rgba, or hsla format.

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_update_elementor_global_typography
tools.description: Add or update global typography styles in the Elementor active kit. Merges by _id — existing entries with matching _id are updated, new _ids are appended.

typography.description: Array of typography objects to add or update.

typography_font_size.description: Font size with unit: { size: 24, unit: "px" }

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_elementor_add_custom_js
tools.description: Add custom JavaScript to an Elementor page by inserting an HTML widget containing a <script> tag into a container. Use for analytics, tracking, animations, or custom interactivity. The JS is stripped of any <script> tags (auto-wrapped).

post_id.description: Page/post ID

parent_id.description: Parent container element ID to insert the script widget into

js.description: JavaScript code (WITHOUT <script> tags — they are added automatically)

position.description: Insert position within parent (-1 = append at end). Default: -1

wrap_dom_ready.description: Wrap code in DOMContentLoaded listener for safe DOM access. Default: false

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_add_stock_image
tools.description: Search for a stock image, download it to the Media Library, and add it as an image widget to a page — all in one call. Builder-agnostic: works with Elementor, Bricks, Beaver Builder, etc. Saves 3 separate tool calls.

post_id.description: Page/post ID to add the image to

query.description: Image search keywords (e.g. "modern office workspace", "happy team meeting")

index.description: Which search result to use (0 = best match). Default: 0

position.description: Insert position within parent (-1 = append). Default: -1

alt_text.description: Alt text for the image (auto-generated from title if omitted)

caption.description: Image caption (CC attribution auto-added if omitted)

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.

tools.name: respira_validate_elementor_json
tools.description: Validate Elementor JSON for rendering fidelity. Catches common conversion issues: missing _margin (causes WordPress default margin injection), missing typography_typography:"custom" flag (causes Elementor to silently ignore fonts), column width collapsing, boxed-vs-fullwidth confusion, and missing mobile breakpoints. Use this to validate JSON from any pipeline (HTML-to-Elementor, manual builds, or external converters) before injection.

json.description: Elementor content tree (array of elements with type, settings, elements). This is the same format used by inject_builder_content.

auto_fix.description: If true, automatically fix error-severity issues and return the corrected JSON. Default: false (validate only).

site_id.description: Optional. Override the active site for this single call without changing the global current site. Use this when running multiple Cowork chats against different WordPress sites in parallel so each chat can pin its own target site per tool call.
